title: Pharmacological Characterization of Crotamine Effects on Mice Hind Limb Paralysis
author: Sunamita Lima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p7xdrpn

steps.title: Adapt mice to experimental box
steps.instruction: Place the mouse into an experimental box (17.6 × 28.7 × 12.5 cm) in a brightly lit room for 15 minutes of adaptation.

steps.title: Apply sucrose solution
steps.instruction: Squirt a 10% sucrose solution on the dorsal coat of the mice after 15 and 30 minutes.

steps.title: Record grooming behavior
steps.instruction: Record the latency to initiate grooming behavior, as well as the frequency and duration of grooming, over the course of 75 minutes of the test.
